brief_summary: Side-view cross-section of one Boba switch. The contact leaf and the bottom coils of the spring render in coral with callouts 'leaf — factory lubed' and 'spring bottom — donut-dipped'. The stem slide rails are dashed warm-grey, called out as 'slide rails — dry'. The top/bottom housing seam carries a 'seam — no give / films have little to fix' annotation. A footer line distinguishes the later factory-lubed runs from the 2020 pre-production run that shipped dry.
